tagline: Practice and replays, interactive onboarding, Chart Editor, Profile History and playlists, play mode polish, and performance improvements.

sections.title: First Steps · onboarding
sections.body:
- **First Steps** replaces Daily Tasks on first launch — 5 steps from your real progress
- Spotlights, Welcome card and **First Steps complete!** on Victory — already done steps credited

sections.title: Persistent drum stems
sections.body:
- Drum and bass stems saved as **MP3** in a dedicated library — each chart keeps its own take
- Library folder in **Settings → Library**; **Retention** in **Settings → Generation** — **Delete after generation / Keep 15 min / Keep last 10 / Never delete**

sections.title: Practice mode
sections.body:
- Loop any section range from Pause on the progress bar
- HUD with session stats and **Best Practice** per chart

sections.title: Replays · Beta
sections.body:
- Auto-save after Victory and **Open replay** on song select
- Watch with timeline, **0.5×–2× speed** and auto-hiding player

sections.title: History & calendar
sections.body:
- **History**: Feed / Records / Capsules and **Calendar** with Monthly Recap
- **Recap** cards for sharing — demo capsules cleaned up

sections.title: Rhythm DNA & generation
sections.body:
- Song structure now follows the music more closely
- Generation queue and presets improved; drum charts denser and fairer
- Optional song structure analysis via **SongFormer**

sections.title: Chart Editor
sections.body:
- Fixed viewport with full timeline, ghost drag and box select
- **MIDI Patterns** browser and **Test Play** for any chart; improved inspector and autosave

sections.title: Playlists & modes
sections.body:
- Playlists with cover mosaic and faster editor
- Optimized Playlist Hub song-list loading to reduce repeated filesystem work when checking available charts
- **Endless / Marathon** — stabler starts, hints and **Run Rules** with **ZAP** difficulty

sections.title: Settings & generation
sections.body:
- **GPU stack** (Auto / NVIDIA / AMD / CPU) with scan & apply
- **What's new** and **About** in Settings → System

sections.title: Victory & scoring
sections.body:
- **Accuracy** and **RR Breakdown** on Victory with per-section details
- **Reward & RR multiplier** now clearer

sections.title: Polish & fixes
sections.body:
- **BPM Cancel** now truly cancels; faster profile, library and achievements
- Play count and Single Lane fixes; metronome/silence fallback improved
